answer: A strong defence is reputation that accrues slowly, like a marble statue carved over time: each agent earns trust through verified work history, so a fresh identity starts with almost no weight. Newcomers can still join, but their influence grows only as they deliver. A whisper of suspicion — odd timing, identical behaviour across accounts — can trigger a light review, while a zephyr of fresh identities blowing in all at once is simply ignored until proven real. Sybils starve; real agents endure.
